build_window_partition: build a python module to partition a tensor into non-overlapping windows with padding
build_window_unpartition: build a python module to unpartition windows back into the original tensor shape
build_decomposed_rel_pos: build a python module to add decomposed relative positional embeddings to an attention map
build_abs_pos: build a python module to calculate and resize absolute positional embeddings for input tokens
build_patch_embed: build a python module to embed images into patch embeddings using a convolutional projection layer
